stem: Which of these does NOT show a line of symmetry?

options.label: A
options.text: [Image: An arrow pointing up with a vertical double-headed line through its center]

options.label: B
options.text: [Image: A horizontally elongated symmetric shape with zigzag edges and a horizontal double-headed line through its center]

options.label: C
options.text: [Image: A triangle with a horizontal double-headed line passing through it]

options.label: D
options.text: [Image: A square with a diagonal double-headed line connecting two opposite vertices]

figure_description: Four shapes labeled A through D, each crossed by a straight line with arrowheads at both ends: A shows a vertically oriented block arrow pointing up, with a vertical line passing through the point of the arrow and the center of its base; B shows a horizontally elongated shape with zigzag top and bottom contours, with a horizontal line passing through the left and right tips; C shows a triangle with a horizontal line passing across it midway between the base and the top vertex; D shows a square with a diagonal line passing through the top-left and bottom-right corners.
